chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who believe and do righteous deeds.
Except for what they voluntarily surrender of themselves.

key_terms.اسْتَحَلَّهُمْ: They made permissible for him / voluntarily surrendered

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Satan having authority over believers?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifying that Satan's dominion is not inherent but contingent upon human free will, specifically when believers voluntarily yield to his whispers. This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle that while Satan has a granted authority (*sultan*), he cannot compel the faithful unless they actively surrender their spiritual vigilance, thereby preserving the integrity of divine justice.
